propositions: A prior plan-review finding with empty evidence list is re-surfaced by recall on every subsequent review without grounding, causing a finding-replay ratchet that never converges.
The recall injection hardcodes evidence:[] and impact:"", losing the original grounding so Pass-2 verifier cannot re-ground the claim against the current plan text.
Prior findings are recalled based only on decision and priority, never consulting material_fingerprint, so edited plans that resolve the finding still trigger recall of the now-stale assertion.
Pass-2 validity backstop fails because the empty-evidence injected candidate carries no quotes to test, and the absence veto never fires when the verifier confirms a bare restatement.
The fix carries prior evidence and impact through recall injection, excludes evidence-less priors from recall eligibility, and suppresses recall when material_fingerprint differs from current.
